jsonld_raw.name: VIBRANT LEATHER FOR HER EDP 80 ML (2.7 FL. OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
VIBRANT LEATHER FOR HER EDP 80 ML (2.7 FL. OZ). A fragrance that balances strength and delicacy in a play of contrasts. The bright top notes of bergamot, lemon, and pear provide a vibrant freshness that gives way to a soft leather accord, enhanced by the lightness of bamboo and a delicate floral aura. In the base, patchouli, papyrus, and vanilla melt into a warm, gourmand trail that wraps the skin in contemporary elegance.

Gourmand chypre | Vibrant, sophisticated, and enveloping.
